the one that remains perfectly constant
the one with the larger population size
questions.explain: Lagged peaks are a hallmark of predator responses to prey abundance.
choice_explanations: Correct. Predator abundance typically trails prey abundance.

Incorrect. Predator-prey cycles usually involve fluctuation.
